Current State: Firewalls are deployed but rule reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: Firewall rules are not formally reviewed on a recurring schedule
Business Impact: Outdated or excessive rules may expose systems to unnecessary network access
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly firewall rule reviews and retain approval evidence

Current State: Cardholder data retention requirements exist but are not consistently reviewed
Gap Identified: Stored cardholder data may remain longer than necessary
Business Impact: Excessive data retention increases exposure during a breach
Recommended Remediation: Define retention periods and securely delete cardholder data when no longer required

Current State: Vulnerability scanning is performed but some high-risk findings remain open beyond target timelines
Gap Identified: Vulnerability remediation deadlines are not consistently enforced
Business Impact: Known vulnerabilities may be exploited before remediation occurs
Recommended Remediation: Define severity-based remediation SLAs and require documented risk acceptance for exceptions

Current State: Role-based access controls exist but periodic reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: User access is not consistently recertified
Business Impact: Users may retain unnecessary access to payment systems or sensitive data
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Current State: MFA is enabled for some administrators but not all
Gap Identified: Administrative access is not fully protected by MFA
Business Impact: Compromised credentials could provide elevated access to cardholder systems
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all administrator and remote access accounts

Current State: Centralized logging is enabled but daily review evidence is incomplete
Gap Identified: Daily security log review is not consistently documented
Business Impact: Suspicious activity may remain undetected or investigation evidence may be incomplete
Recommended Remediation: Document daily log reviews and retain alert investigation records

Current State: Vulnerability scanning occurs but penetration testing is inconsistent
Gap Identified: Recurring penetration testing is not formally scheduled
Business Impact: Security weaknesses may remain unidentified between assessments
Recommended Remediation: Perform penetration testing at least annually and after significant changes

Current State: Policies and training exist but incident response testing is incomplete
Gap Identified: The incident response plan has not been validated through a recent exercise
Business Impact: The organization may respond slowly or inconsistently during a payment-card security incident
Recommended Remediation: Conduct an annual tabletop exercise and document lessons learned

Current State: Third-party payment providers are used but recurring reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: Critical service providers are not consistently reassessed for security risk
Business Impact: Vendor weaknesses could expose payment systems or customer data
Recommended Remediation: Perform annual security reassessments of critical service providers

Current State: Physical security controls are primarily managed by cloud providers
Gap Identified: Cloud provider physical security evidence has not been formally reviewed
Business Impact: Insufficient assurance may exist over physical protection of hosted systems
Recommended Remediation: Review cloud provider compliance reports and physical security attestations
